How to link a WhatsApp Business account

On the phone that has this WhatsApp Business number:

1. Open WhatsApp Business
2. Tap ⋮ (or Settings) → Linked devices → Link a device
3. Scan the QR code shown here.

QR can't be scanned (same phone)? Tap "Log in with phone number" on this screen and type the 8-character code into WhatsApp Business → Linked devices → Link with phone number.

Open the WhatsApp Business phone at least once every 14 days to keep the link active.

MultiBiz keeps up to 5 WhatsApp Business accounts logged in at the same time, each fully isolated, with its own name and color.

ADD AN ACCOUNT
1. Tap "Add account" and enter a name (e.g. "Sharma Electronics").
2. A QR code appears.
3. On the phone with that business number: WhatsApp Business → ⋮ → Linked devices → Link a device → scan the QR.
 • Same phone? Use "Log in with phone number" and enter the code.

NOTIFICATIONS
Every notification shows "Account name • Sender", the account color and its initials, so you always know which business got the message. Each account has its own notification channel – you can set a different ringtone per account.

FOR RELIABLE BACKGROUND MESSAGES
• Allow "Background running" (battery optimisation off).
• On Xiaomi/Redmi/Oppo/Vivo/Realme: also enable Autostart and set battery to "No restrictions".
• Don't force-stop the app.

The WhatsApp Business phone must open WhatsApp at least once every 14 days, otherwise the link expires.
